Hi Karthik,

Hope you're well. We're getting the compliance intake looped in for our upcoming deployment of Redwood Inference. Two asks from our side: a SOC 2 controls walkthrough / DPA alignment conversation, and confirmation of a pen-test window (vendor will run external pentest).

High level:
- We'd like a 60–90 minute walkthrough covering SOC 2 scope, data flows (private vs hosted), retention/audit logs, and any controls evidence you can share.
- Pen-test window: target weeks May 15–19 or May 22–26 (we can be flexible if you have capacity).
- Please share your security questionnaire (or a prefilled questionnaire) and an NDA if needed before we start.

Can you propose a few slots next week? Also please include who from Redwood will be on the call (engineering/security presenters).

Thanks,
